phases.title: Setup and seeing
lessons: Trivial fade — prove the loop
Same fade, but scrub it backwards by eye before reading the numbers

phases.title: Weight and timing (eases)
lessons: One word fades in at three durations — find the true one
Same move with linear vs power2.out vs power4.out — name the difference in one sentence
A shape overshoots into place with back.out — tune the overshoot until it stops looking silly
Two identical words, one eased one linear, side by side in A/B mode — which reads as "alive"?
Bounce a dot to a stop with a custom ease you hand-tune, not a preset
Anticipation: a small pull-back before the main move (principle #2)
Match a real-world weight (a heavy door vs a ping-pong ball) using only duration + ease
Slow in / slow out on a straight-line move — no easing preset, hand-placed keyframes via multiple tweens

phases.title: Type as material
lessons: Reveal a headline word by word with staggered opacity
Split a word into letters and stagger their rise (SplitText)
Animate font-variation-settings weight from thin to bold on hover-less loop
Kinetic type: one sentence, one word emphasized by scale + weight change mid-timeline
Type tracking (letter-spacing) animates tight-to-loose as a reveal
Two-line headline where line 2 arrives while line 1 is still settling (overlap, not sequence)

phases.title: Sequencing (the edit)
lessons: Three elements enter in sequence using position parameters, not manual delays
Same three elements, now overlapping by 30% — feel the difference from lesson 1
A label-driven timeline: tl.addLabel() to mark 'intro'/'hold'/'exit' and scrub between them
Exit before the next entrance starts — no dead air, no overlap
One timeline nested inside another (a sub-timeline for a repeating unit)
Re-time an existing rep: same elements, cut its total duration by 40% without losing the beats

phases.title: Transitions and continuity
lessons: Flip: a box moves from one layout position to another, animated by Flip.from()
Flip a shared element between two 'scenes' inside one timeline (a fake page transition)
Crossfade two states of the same element (color + position) using Flip vs. manual tween — compare
A card expands to fill the stage and back down (Flip + scale)
Stagger a Flip across a small grid of elements reflowing from 3 columns to 1

phases.title: Scroll as time (ScrollTrigger)
lessons: Pin a word and scrub its entrance tied to scroll position instead of time
A progress bar driven by ScrollTrigger instead of the harness scrub slider
Scrub a multi-step sequence (3 beats) across one long scroll region
Toggle a class on enter/leave using ScrollTrigger callbacks, not tweened opacity
